name: mm-prefill-n64
command: for c in "ref 16 0" "ref 4 0" "vF 16 0" "vF 4 0" "vS 4 0" "vSW 16 6" "vSW 8 6" "vSW 4 6"; do set -- $c; ./kbench/kbench_$1 --variant $1-g$2-w$3 --group $2 --wide $3 --dtypes q4k --shapes qkv,gate,out,down --threads 4 --batch 64; done

state_before.cmdline: coherent_pool=1M 8250.nr_uarts=0 snd_bcm2835.enable_headphones=0 cgroup_disable=memory numa_policy=interleave nvme.max_host_mem_size_mb=32 snd_bcm2835.enable_headphones=1 snd_bcm2835.enable_hdmi=1 snd_bcm2835.enable_hdmi=0  numa=fake=2 system_heap.max_order=0 iommu_dma_numa_policy=interleave smsc95xx.macaddr=<pi-mac> vc_mem.mem_base=0x3eb00000 vc_mem.mem_size=0x3ff00000  console=ttyS0,115200 console=tty1 root=PARTUUID=393ab1fb-02 rootfstype=ext4 fsck.repair=yes rootwait cfg80211.ieee80211_regdom=KR

state_after.cmdline: coherent_pool=1M 8250.nr_uarts=0 snd_bcm2835.enable_headphones=0 cgroup_disable=memory numa_policy=interleave nvme.max_host_mem_size_mb=32 snd_bcm2835.enable_headphones=1 snd_bcm2835.enable_hdmi=1 snd_bcm2835.enable_hdmi=0  numa=fake=2 system_heap.max_order=0 iommu_dma_numa_policy=interleave smsc95xx.macaddr=<pi-mac> vc_mem.mem_base=0x3eb00000 vc_mem.mem_size=0x3ff00000  console=ttyS0,115200 console=tty1 root=PARTUUID=393ab1fb-02 rootfstype=ext4 fsck.repair=yes rootwait cfg80211.ieee80211_regdom=KR
